about: The disco light (add-forensic-flashlight), toggled on B. A disco ball floats in front of the player. ball: where it appears when switched on, relative to the eye and the way the player faces (metres: right, up, back; -Z is ahead; 0.95 m away, 33 degrees to the left and 17 degrees up, so looking level it sits in the upper-left corner of the view, cut by the left and top edges (16:9, 45 degree vertical field of view; the user's reference screenshot, 2026-11-17)), and how fast it spins (turns per second). It stays at that place while on. pulse: near a clock (the nearest within reach_m whose beats the engine reports) it swells by depth on each heard beat and settles over decay_seconds. beams: the ring of spotlights it throws (count, colours alternating, sRGB; intensity in lumens at reference_tilt_deg, each beam scaled by the square of how much farther its spot lands; width in degrees; light range in metres; tilt below the horizon in degrees, taken in turn so neighbouring spots land near and far, out to about 27 m from a ball 2 m up; user, 2026-11-18: many small beams; up_count beams more go up, above the horizon by up_tilt_deg in turn, between the downward ones, at the base intensity, for lighting what is above later). reveal: a collectible within range_m whose heading from the ball is within width_deg of a beam's flares, then fades over fade_seconds. hologram: rim and core colours (sRGB; glow multiplies them for bloom), scanlines per metre and their scroll speed, flicker 0..1. beacon: the column and diamond over each revealed collectible.
